points.interpretation: Registers common callback with filter 7 and user data 1.

points.name: settings.wear.right_crown_register

points.name: settings.wear.event_code
points.interpretation: The common callback gates the indexed dispatch on event code 7.

points.name: settings.wear.event_data
points.interpretation: The common callback uses the returned word directly as an index into a 28-byte-stride table before switching on its selected field.

points.name: settings.wear.wrist_caption
points.interpretation: Sets the wrist.settings translation on the wrist group label.

points.name: settings.wear.crown_caption
points.interpretation: Sets the crown.settings translation on the crown group label.

evidence: The settings manifest registers the descriptor. The create routine reads persistent wrist/crown state, builds two groups of radio options, and registers the common callback with event filter 7 and indices 0 through 3. The callback uses the event data as a table index, and writes wrist or crown properties based on the table entry. Destroy clears the title-view state slot and releases the radio groups.
scope: Recorded registration and event-getter calls only; other property writers and device orientation paths are not covered.
limitations: The callback computes a table address from the supplied index without a visible bounds check. Invalid event data can access invalid memory. Changing a selection alters persistent device orientation. State and root slots are not thread synchronization. Device behavior and recovery are unverified.
